decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed means of access and associated parking area by reason of its width, design and appearance, would not be detrimental to the visual amenity of the street scene or the adjoining properties; nor would it give rise to conditions prejudicial to road safety and to the free flow of traffic. It is therefore is deemed to be in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) T.4.4 (Road Safety) and T.5.3. (Vehicle Crossings and Hardstandings) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 5 - The width of the means of access at the property's front boundary shall be no greater than 2.4m.  A wall of a height not greater than 1m shall be erected along the entire width of the front boundary with the exception of the means of access before construction of the crossover begins.

Condition : 6 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
